1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Penapisan Filem (Larangan) 2019.

Larangan

2. Penayangan, pempameran, pengedaran, pemilikan, penyebaran atau penjualan

filem yang diperihalkan dalam Jadual dan bahan publisiti filem itu yang akan

bertentangan dengan kepentingan awam dilarang di seluruh Malaysia.

FILM CENSORSHIP ACT 2002

FILM CENSORSHIP (PROHIBITION) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 26 of the Film Censorship Act 2002

[Act 620], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Film Censorship (Prohibition) Order 2019.

Prohibition

2. The exhibition, display, distribution, possession, circulation or sale of the film

described in the Schedule and the film-publicity material for that film which would be

contrary to public interest are prohibited throughout Malaysia.
